text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Did ya hear? This year's Summer Training Camp, on one of the days 
off there's going to be a 『Deserted Island Survival Competition』!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I saw…… how are they competing?
Yeah, I saw…… how are they competing?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's see…… Points will be evaluated based on 『Safety』 『Security』 
and 『A Survival Experience To Envy』, is what's written.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When I hear the words, Survival, I can't just stand idly by! 
Hey, Trainer——Give it a try with me!

And so, it was now one of those days off during Summer Training 
Camp. Daring Heart and I had arrived at the Deserted Island.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And now, we're here! 
I'd like to admire this beautiful scenery but……
choice_data_list: We should set up a base camp first, right?
We should set up a base camp first, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Survival is a competition of how you 
spend your time! Just like we planned last night, 
let's be efficient and take things one at a time!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We're in luck! This cave is just right, isn't it? 
For now, let's start here!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For water, there was a river on the way here so…… next 
is gathering provisions. Trainer, can you gather some 
tree branches and vines that might be useable as rope?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! We'll make a simple trap and set it up first. 
And we've already got permission for it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And after that, we'll head to the mountain. While searching for 
ingredients, we'll check for anything useful that washed ashore!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hey! I'm dropping it!
(Shuffle shuffle)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice catch! 
And with this, we've got a little Vitamin Dessert!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu, this island is blessed with luck when it comes to things 
washed ashore. ……I'm done! Now the hammock's done! Try getting on.

And so, steeling myself, I climbed 
in to the hammock made by Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: How is it? Comfy?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Glad to hear that! 
After a short break, let's go check on the river traps!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fish, fruits. 
And the water is boiling……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu…… perfect if I do say so myself! 
……Okay, I'm going to go wash my hands.

As she headed off towards our water source, 
I looked over our perfectly organized base camp.

The food and the sleeping arrangements were perfect. 
There was nothing to complain about.

But, one of the criteria was 『A Survival Experience To Envy』. 
……But maybe just being 『Perfect』 wouldn't be enough——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm back——Hey, what's up? 
Furrowing your brow like that.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Really?

I tell her what I was thinking earlier. 
『To win, don't we need something more?』……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: …………You really……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You really are the best! 
You're fire!
choice_data_list: No, I might just be overthinking……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just like you said. What we were aiming for 
wasn't 『Perfect』, it was 『A Survival Experience To Envy』!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! Now that we've decided, 
there's no time. Let's go look for some materials!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll show it off. 
This base camp!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Flowers and…… maybe using empty cans almost like candles for 
light. Anyways, we're just going for glamorous and emotional.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For this competition…… this is where things really start! 
Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look…… sea glass! 
Let's gather a bunch and set them on the table!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Huh, what are you doing?
choice_data_list: I thought this might look good

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Wow……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice idea! Hey, how about making one more? 
It would be even more lovely if we matched!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Stylish and comfy. 
No matter how you look at it, it's a base camp to 『Envy』!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heh! 
All that's left is to get a photo to submit…… oh!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right, I need to put this on! 
Same to you too!

And so, the 『Deserted Island 
Survival Competition』 safely came to a close……

text_block_list.name: Survival Competition Judge
text_block_list.text:
Glorious! The 『Deserted Island Survival Competition』 
winner is…… the Daring Heart pair! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Survival Competition Judge
text_block_list.text:
And the prize is——the 『Perfect Survival Set』! 
Feel free to use it during training too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: 『Perfect Survival Set』……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, Ahahaa! 
……Looks like our next "Date" is another Deserted Island, huh?

After dinner. 
We came to the beach to celebrate our victory again.
choice_data_list: Phew…… it's so quiet, isn't it?
Phew…… it's so quiet, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
……Fufuu, feeling a little relieved?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……I'm really sorry. 
For always dragging you along to such lively places.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Really, even though you probably prefer these kinds of quiet places. 
……if you really don't want to, you can just clearly say no, you know?
choice_data_list: I don't mind at all. It's all new experiences

text_block_list.text: And above it all, when I'm with Daring Heart——
choice_data_list: I stop thinking that I'm plain and boring

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What? 
Boring…… you?

I nod while looking out to sea. ……I'm always second-guessing myself, 
failing to take action. That boring side of me, when I'm with her——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ——You're joking, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be kidding me! 
There aren't many people as fun as you are!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Your world is always swirling with mysteries and questions. 
So many mysteries and questions that I can't even see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I love that kind of world. 
I love hearing about your world, directly from you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You get it? That curiosity and desire to know, 
you could say it's stolen my Heart!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Do you understand?

I was surprised. 
That Daring Heart would see it that way……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Fufu. Not really.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's my line though, my heart?
